note: Cannes 2020 was cancelled. The 2021 festival judged work from 2020 and 2021 together (canneslions.com day-1 page: "Juries have been judging work from across 2020 and 2021"; juries could award one Grand Prix per year). Official counts and the reasonwhy.es Excel files (sheet "WinnersDetailsPress_DualYear") are one merged set with no per-year field, so no separate 2020-web.json is written.

Radio & Audio.note: Day-4 page total (34) does not equal its own G+S+B+GP (30); G/S/B taken as stated.

Innovation.note: Day-4 page gives no Gold count; total 5 = GP + 1 Silver + 3 Bronze implies 0 Gold.

Titanium.note: Day-5 page gives total 7 (6 Titanium Lions + Grand Prix); no per-level breakdown.
